title: Phones & syncing
blurb: Work email on a phone, photos to the computer, Phone Link, iPhone and Android.

remedies.title: Send files between my phone and computer without a cable
remedies.why: Several built-in and free tools move files over Wi-Fi.

steps.text: Windows: Phone Link, Nearby Share/Quick Share (Android), or OneDrive.
Mac: AirDrop from iPhone; Android via Google Drive or Quick Share apps.
DeskSpan (a DeskLab app) sends phone files to your computer's Downloads.

remedies.title: Back up my iPhone to the computer
remedies.why: A computer backup is a full copy, independent of iCloud storage.

steps.text: Connect the iPhone, open Apple Devices (or iTunes) › Back up now; tick Encrypt to include passwords.
Connect the iPhone, select it in Finder's sidebar › Back Up Now; tick Encrypt local backup.
Backups are big; check free space first.

remedies.title: Use my phone as a webcam
remedies.why: Phones have far better cameras than most laptops.

steps.text: Mac + iPhone: Continuity Camera works automatically; choose the iPhone in the app's camera list.
Windows 11 + Android: Phone Link › Connected camera; or apps like Camo or DroidCam.
